name: 寬幅圖片輪播＋下方置中標題組
desc: 對齊內容寬度的寬幅圖片輪播，附分頁點與圓形進度計數器，下方置中放一組較窄的標題組。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。上方是一張寬幅的圖片輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，佔區塊大部分高度；輪播會自動切換：圖片右下角有一個圓形計數器，中間顯示目前是第幾張，外圈是進度環，會隨該張的停留時間逐漸畫滿，畫滿後切到下一張；圖片下緣置中有一排分頁點，目前那一張的點拉長變寬，其他維持圓點，每個點都可以點擊切換到對應的那張。圖片下方置中放標題組，文字置中，寬度明顯窄於圖片；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：圖片輪播接近畫面全寬，只在左右留少許邊，圖片仍為橫式；標題組仍置中放在圖片下方，分頁點與圓形進度計數器保留。

en.name: Wide image slideshow + centered heading group below
en.desc: A wide image slideshow aligned to the content width, with pagination dots and a circular progress counter, followed by a narrower centered heading group.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. At the top is a wide image slideshow aligned to the page content width, taking up most of the section height; the slideshow advances automatically: in the bottom-right corner of the image is a circular counter showing the current slide number, ringed by a progress ring that gradually fills over the time each slide is shown and switches to the next slide once full; a row of pagination dots sits centered along the bottom edge of the image, where the current slide's dot stretches wider while the others stay round, and each dot can be clicked to switch to its slide. Below the image, place the heading group centered, with centered text, clearly narrower than the image. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally: the image slideshow spans nearly the full viewport width with only a small margin on the left and right, and the image remains landscape; the heading group stays centered below the image, and the pagination dots and circular progress counter are kept.
